Input.string:
--- Sightless --- Base Critical Strike Chance for Attacks with Weapons is 12% You are Blind
-- Directionless --- Projectiles have 50% chance to return to you Projectiles are fired in random directions
--- Careless --- Skills fire 2 additional Projectiles
--- Lightless --- 5% increased Maximum Life per Abyss Jewel affecting you 5% increased Maximum Mana per Abyss Jewel affecting you
